title: redact leaves a host inside a url unchanged, so an internal url in a question passes the spool, kbmon output and coord asks
goal: redact.redact rewrites the host of an http or https url to the host placeholder when the public root never names it, as it does a bare host, keeping url hosts the public root names, as querylog.md's table says an FQDN becomes corp.example.com

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import redact;o=redact.redact('open https://ci7.qzvx-internal.net/x');print(o);sys.exit(1 if 'qzvx' in o else 0)

notes: Found 2026-10-23 by the SP-c7oav2vn fresh review; pre-existing (HOST's lookbehind skips a host after //). Not S1: the store never holds question text (querylog.md:149) and a lead url's host passes ql_store's own public-host gate; the url reaches only local surfaces.
